key.name: size-mode
key.description: Controls icon size, font size, spacing, and roundness. Options: small, medium, large.

key.name: position
key.description: Where to place the workspace bar in the top panel. Options: left, center, right.

key.name: position-index
key.summary: Position index within the panel box
key.description: Index position within the chosen panel box (left, center, or right). 0 = first position. Higher values move it further along.

key.name: show-icons-background
key.description: When enabled, a subtle fill is drawn behind the workspace icons. Disable for a flatter look.

key.name: legibility-shadows
key.description: When enabled, the workspace numbers and window icons cast a soft shadow, and a thin shaded rim is drawn just outside each pill border, keeping the bar readable over transparent panels. On by default.

key.name: enable-animations
key.description: When enabled, workspace and icon changes (opening, closing, moving, creating, reordering) animate smoothly. On by default.

key.name: focus-scale-effect
key.description: When enabled, the icon of the focused window is shown at full size while unfocused icons are slightly shrunk, with a smooth transition when focus changes.

key.name: magnification-spacing
key.description: Gap in pixels between workspace groups near the cursor, with a minimum supplied by the size preset. It blends back to normal preset spacing outside the magnification region. Number-to-own-icons spacing is automatic and uses the visible digit or active circle. App-to-app gaps retain their normal preset spacing.

key.name: show-active-workspace-ring
key.description: Draw an accent-colored circle around the active workspace number only while the bar is magnified.

key.name: focus-scale-reduction
key.description: Percentage by which unfocused icons are shrunk (5 = barely noticeable, 95 = nearly invisible).

key.name: combine-icons
key.description: When enabled, multiple windows of the same application on the same workspace are shown as a single icon with a window-count badge. Clicking the combined icon opens a list of that application's windows to pick from; dragging it moves all of its windows at once, while dragging a window out of the list moves just that one. Off by default.

key.name: gesture-horizontal-switch-workspaces
key.description: Horizontal scrolling and two-finger swipes switch workspaces across the bar, overriding the per-target horizontal actions.

key.name: gesture-app-left-click
key.description: Action for left click over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-app-middle-click
key.description: Action for middle click over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-app-right-click
key.description: Action for right click over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-app-scroll-up
key.summary: Scroll / Swipe Up on app targets
key.description: Action for scroll / swipe up over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-app-scroll-down
key.summary: Scroll / Swipe Down on app targets
key.description: Action for scroll / swipe down over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-app-horizontal-scroll
key.summary: Horizontal Scroll / Swipe on app targets
key.description: Action for horizontal scroll / swipe over an app icon. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-left-click
key.description: Action for left click over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-middle-click
key.description: Action for middle click over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-right-click
key.description: Action for right click over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-scroll-up
key.summary: Scroll / Swipe Up on workspace targets
key.description: Action for scroll / swipe up over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-scroll-down
key.summary: Scroll / Swipe Down on workspace targets
key.description: Action for scroll / swipe down over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: gesture-workspace-horizontal-scroll
key.summary: Horizontal Scroll / Swipe on workspace targets
key.description: Action for horizontal scroll / swipe over a workspace number or background. Applies in normal and magnified views.

key.name: middle-click-close
key.description: When enabled, middle-clicking an app icon closes that window; a combined icon closes all of its windows at once, and a row in its expanded window list closes just that one. Middle-clicking anywhere else on a workspace button still toggles the Overview. Off by default, so the previous middle-click behaviour is preserved on upgrade.

key.name: dim-inactive-icons
key.description: When enabled, the icon of every window except the focused one is drawn at reduced opacity.

key.name: desaturate-inactive-icons
key.description: When enabled, the icon of every window except the focused one is drawn in grayscale.

key.name: hide-empty-last-workspace
key.description: With dynamic workspaces, GNOME always keeps one empty workspace at the end of the list. When enabled, that workspace is not shown in the bar; it is only hidden, never removed. It shows again while it is the active workspace and as soon as a window is placed on it. Has no effect with a fixed number of workspaces. On by default.

key.name: enable-magnification
key.description: Magnify workspace numbers and app icons when hovering over the workspace bar.

key.name: show-advanced-magnification
key.description: Show detailed magnification controls. Hiding them keeps their configured values.

key.name: magnification-peak-mode
key.description: Choose a size relative to the normal icon or an absolute pixel size.

key.name: magnification-peak-pixels
key.description: Absolute peak size; icons never shrink below their normal size.

key.name: magnification-scale
key.description: Largest app icon size, as a percentage of normal size or in pixels. 100% keeps the normal size.

key.name: magnification-minimum-peak-size
key.description: Minimum size of a fully magnified app icon, in pixels. This keeps small size presets readable; 0 disables the minimum.

key.name: magnification-reach
key.description: Maximum distance affected on each side of the cursor, as a percentage of a normal icon width. Adaptive width can shrink this for fewer shown apps.

key.name: magnification-sharpness
key.description: 100% gives a Gaussian bell. Higher values make the centre more pointed with longer tails; lower values flatten the centre and steepen the shoulders.

key.name: magnification-app-only
key.summary: Ignore Workspace Numbers in the Curve
key.description: Treat numbers and workspace separators as one normal app gap when calculating app sizes. Turn off to use their full on-screen distance.

key.name: magnification-number-mode
key.description: Follow Icon matches the nearest app. Own Workspace grows numbers only over their own workspace. Normal Size removes growth. Numbers stay vertically aligned with their nearest app in every mode.

key.name: magnification-number-scale
key.description: Percentage of the extra growth applied to numbers. 100% follows the usual growth; 0% removes growth without changing app icons.

key.name: magnification-empty-numbers
key.description: Let a number grow even when its workspace has no app icons to follow.

key.name: magnification-empty-hover-only
key.summary: Empty Numbers Grow Only on Hover
key.description: Keep neighbouring empty numbers at normal size. Turn off to let the curve affect them from nearby.

key.name: magnification-preset-app-gap
key.description: Keep app-to-app gaps from the normal size preset. Turn off to use the custom gap below.

key.name: magnification-app-gap
key.description: Automatic keeps normal app gaps. Custom sets the gap in pixels; Marker Spacing controls its distribution inside the cutoff. Moving markers changes where apps sample the curve. The curve itself stays fixed.

key.name: magnification-preset-number-gap
key.description: Keep the automatic gap from a visible digit or circle to its own icons. Turn off to set a custom gap.

key.name: magnification-number-gap
key.description: Gap from the visible digit or circle to its own app group near the cursor, in pixels. Does not change workspace-to-workspace spacing.

key.name: magnification-preset-group-minimum
key.description: Keep a small size-preset gutter between neighbouring workspace groups, even when Workspace Group Gap is zero.

key.name: magnification-group-minimum
key.description: Smallest allowed gap between workspace groups near the cursor, in pixels. Zero allows groups to touch.

key.name: magnification-trim-number-padding
key.description: Pack numbers using the visible digit or circle. Turn off to reserve the full original number cell, leaving more space around numbers.

key.name: magnification-number-padding
key.description: Extra margin reserved around a magnified digit or circle, in normal-size pixels. This margin grows with the number.

key.name: magnification-vertical-alignment
key.description: Dock Curve keeps icons anchored to the panel edge. Centre Line puts the centres of all magnified items on one horizontal line.

key.name: magnification-lift
key.description: Move the magnified row farther into the desktop, in pixels. Works upward from a bottom panel and downward from a top panel.

key.name: magnification-number-offset
key.description: Move only workspace numbers relative to their icons. Positive values move into the desktop; negative values move back toward the panel.

key.name: magnification-circle-padding
key.description: Inset from the number cell on each side, in pixels. A larger value makes the active circle smaller.

key.name: magnification-circle-width
key.description: Thickness of the accent-coloured circle, in pixels before magnification.

key.name: magnification-circle-opacity
key.description: Visibility of the active circle, from 0% transparent to 100% opaque.

key.name: magnification-optical-strength
key.description: Compensate for uneven visual weight in digits such as 4. 100% is the normal correction; 0% uses the digit bounding box.

key.name: magnification-circle-offset-x
key.description: Move the circle relative to its digit, in pixels before magnification. Positive values move right; negative values move left.

key.name: magnification-circle-offset-y
key.description: Move the circle relative to its digit, in pixels before magnification. Positive values move down; negative values move up.

key.name: magnification-duration
key.description: Time in milliseconds for hover entry, exit, empty-number growth and circle spacing changes. Zero makes transitions immediate.

key.name: magnification-easing
key.description: Ease Out starts quickly and settles gently. Ease In and Out softens both ends. Linear changes at a constant speed.

key.name: magnification-frame-opacity
key.description: How much of the normal workspace frames remains visible while fully magnified. 0% hides the frames; 100% keeps them visible.

key.name: magnification-icon-opacity
key.description: Visibility of magnified app icons, from 0% transparent to 100% opaque.

key.name: magnification-number-opacity
key.description: Visibility of magnified numbers and their circles, from 0% transparent to 100% opaque.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-enabled
key.description: Mark the focused window with a coloured glow beneath its magnified app icon.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-opacity
key.description: Visibility of the focused app highlight. 0% hides it; 100% makes the centre fully opaque.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-softness
key.description: 100% uses the original soft fade. Lower values sharpen the edge; 0% draws a solid ellipse.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-width
key.description: Stretch or narrow the glow horizontally. 100% keeps its original width; it scales with the app icon.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-height
key.description: Stretch or flatten the glow vertically. 100% keeps its original height; it scales with the app icon.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-offset
key.description: Extra distance from the icon’s lowest visible pixel, in logical pixels. Positive moves down; negative moves up. The screen edge limits downward movement.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-color-mode
key.description: Use the app icon’s tint, the GNOME accent colour, or your own colour.

key.name: magnification-focus-highlight-color
key.description: Choose the colour used when Highlight Colour is set to Custom.

key.name: magnification-icon-shadow-opacity
key.description: Darkness of the shadow behind magnified app icons. Set to 0% to remove the shadow.

key.name: magnification-icon-shadow-blur
key.description: Softness of the app icon shadow, in pixels. Zero produces a sharp shadow.

key.name: magnification-icon-shadow-offset
key.description: Vertical distance of the app icon shadow below the icon, in pixels.

key.name: magnification-number-shadow-opacity
key.description: Darkness of the shadow behind magnified digits. Set to 0% to remove the shadow.

key.name: magnification-number-shadow-blur
key.description: Softness of the number shadow, in pixels. Zero produces a sharp shadow.

key.name: magnification-number-shadow-offset
key.description: Vertical distance of the number shadow below the digit, in pixels.

key.name: magnification-drag-delay
key.description: How long to hold a magnified item before dragging begins and the normal workspace bar returns, in milliseconds.

key.name: magnification-cutoff
key.description: End magnification at this percentage of the curve width on either side. Beyond the shaded boundary, sizes and gaps are exactly normal.

key.name: magnification-cutoff-softness
key.description: Fade to normal inside the cutoff boundary. 0% makes an immediate piecewise cutoff; the shaded region always stays normal.

key.name: magnification-adaptive-reach
key.description: Enable explicit app-count-dependent compression. Fixed mode keeps c independent of app count.

key.name: magnification-reach-reference
key.description: Shown app count at which the curve uses its configured width. The selected width mode determines which side of this count narrows the curve.

key.name: magnification-example-count
key.description: Number of apps in the graph. This previews dynamic compression; the live bar uses its actual shown app count.

key.name: magnification-spacing-mode
key.description: Uniform uses the custom app gap throughout the affected region. Bell Curve follows magnification. Diminishing reduces extra spacing toward the cutoff.

key.name: magnification-spacing-falloff
key.description: How quickly diminishing extra spacing falls toward the normal gap. Higher values concentrate spacing near the cursor.

key.name: magnification-reach-response
key.description: Fewer Icons narrows below the reference count. More Icons narrows above it, keeping a crowded bar compact.

key.name: magnification-compression
key.description: c in f(cx): 1 keeps the base width; larger values narrow the bell and smaller values widen it. The pixel coordinate system stays fixed.

key.name: magnification-cutoff-distance
key.description: Distance on each side of the cursor in GNOME logical pixels. Beyond it, app scale and spacing are exactly normal. Independent of compression c.

key.name: magnification-graph-span
key.description: Pixel distance shown on each side of the graph. This zooms only the editor; it never changes magnification.

key.name: magnification-graph-zoom
key.description: 100% shows real logical-pixel size. Both axes and icons always use the same zoom.

key.name: empty-workspace-cooldown
key.description: Seconds to preserve empty workspaces before occupied ones. Filling a workspace cancels its current grace period. If it becomes empty again, a new period starts. At expiry GNOME applies its normal dynamic-workspace cleanup. Zero disables preservation.

key.name: magnification-cutoff-enabled
key.description: Return to normal size and spacing beyond the cutoff distance. Disable to use the full curve without clipping.

key.name: magnification-visible-tools
key.description: Independent graph nodes shown in the magnification editor. These choices do not change numeric settings panels or their expansion.

key.name: magnification-active-preset
key.description: Selected built-in or numbered custom curve and app-spacing preset.

key.name: magnification-custom-presets
key.description: Saved numbered custom curves and app-spacing configurations.
